_comment: Which mesh on a figure is clothing, hair, a shoe, an accessory — or the body itself.
Fitted to 96 distinct mesh-node names across twenty captured figures, and DATA rather than code
because that set is never finished: the next capture arrives with a word nobody listed.
Adding one should be an edit, not a release. Bump `revision` when you do — every import records
which revision classified it, so a change says which assets are worth reclassifying instead of
silently disagreeing with the ones already catalogued.
Rules are tried IN ORDER and the first match wins, so the specific ones come first. Matching is
case-insensitive substring, because these names run together — `clothes_weddingdress_heels_L`

Rules are tried IN ORDER and the first match wins. SPECIFIC FIRST, with `body` LAST: it is the least specific category and its matches (`model_britney`, `agnes`) are substrings of the more specific ones (`model_britney_hair`). Matching is case-insensitive substring, because these names run together — `clothes_weddingdress_heels_L` is a shoe and a word-boundary rule finds none.
_removable_note: Categories a figure can be stripped of. `face` and `body` are not removable: taking the eyes out
of a head is not undressing it. `hair` is removable but is NOT clothing — stripping a figure to
check its integrity should not scalp it, so it is its own category and its own toggle.
